summary: Feely's campaign platform pledges to "stand unapologetically with Israel" and strengthen the U.S.-Israel relationship, calling Israel "America's greatest Middle East ally." In October 2025 he urged continued support for Israel and declared Hamas must accept Trump's peace deal "or face annihilation." In October 2023 he affirmed Israel's "every right to defend itself." His platform frames the issue around fighting domestic antisemitism on college campuses.
